name: motion-dialog
title: Motion dialog
description: A Base UI dialog whose panel rises and settles on a spring, interruptible mid-exit.
docs:
## When to use - A focused task that must interrupt: confirmations, short forms, destructive actions. - Content that needs a modal, focus trapping, and a clear escape route. - Any overlay where closing should feel like the panel "settles back" rather than vanishing. ## When not to use - Non-blocking hints and menus; use a popover or tooltip. - Long multi-step flows; use a page or a wizard. - Mobile sheets with drag gestures; use a drawer component. ## Installation ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @cadence/motion-dialog ``` ## Usage ```tsx import { MotionDialog } from "@/components/cadence/motion-dialog/motion-dialog"; export function DeleteProject() { return (
); } ``` ## API | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | `ReactNode` | – | Content of the trigger button. | | `title` | `string` | – | Dialog title; required for accessibility. | | `description` | `string` | – | Optional supporting text. | | `children` | `ReactNode` | – | Dialog body. | | `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `"md"` | Max width. | | `open` | `boolean` | – | Controlled open state. | | `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | – | Called on open and close. | | `className` | `string` | – | Merged onto the panel. | ## Motion contract | Phase | Properties | Token | Interruptible | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | enter | backdrop `opacity 0 → 1`; panel `opacity`, `translateY 8px → 0`, `scale 0.96 → 1` | `popup.anchored` (0.4s spring) | yes | | exit | panel `opacity → 0`, `scale → 0.98`, `translateY 4px` | `popup.anchored` | yes | | reduced | opacity only | `exit.fade` / `popup.anchored` short | yes | | none | instant | – | – | ## Keyboard interactions | Keys | Action | | --- | --- | | Tab / Shift+Tab | Cycles focus inside the dialog. | | Escape | Closes the dialog and returns focus to the trigger. | | Enter / Space | Activates the focused control. | ## Accessibility - Base UI provides the modal semantics: `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby`, focus trap, focus return, scroll lock, and Escape handling. - The close button has an explicit `aria-label`. - The title is required; a dialog without an accessible name is invalid. - The panel is removed only after its exit animation finishes, so focus is never lost mid-flight. ## Responsive behavior The viewport centers the panel and scrolls when the content is taller than the screen. `size` caps the width; on mobile the panel is always full-width minus page padding. ## Performance - Only one panel tree is mounted while open; content is unmounted on close. - Animates opacity and transform only; the backdrop uses a subtle blur (2px), which is cheap but can be removed on low-end devices. ## Notes for AI - Always pass a `title`; it is the accessible name. - For destructive actions, keep the confirm button's label specific ("Delete project", not "OK"). - If you need a non-modal popover, use Base UI Popover instead of this component.
